claims.claim: BERT selects 15% of WordPiece positions and uses 80/10/10 replacement; only selected positions contribute direct MLM prediction loss.
The official BERT preprocessing script supports duplicate factor and whole-word masking options.
The official BERT script defaults dupe_factor to 10, creating multiple pre-generated masking variants.
claims.verification_note: Distinguishes offline duplicate generation from per-epoch remasking.

claims.claim: RoBERTa compares static and dynamic masking; Table 1 results are close, with dynamic masking comparable or slightly better.
claims.verification_note: Preserves metric names and development-set context.

claims.claim: Whole-word masking groups WordPiece pieces belonging to one original word before selecting prediction positions.
claims.verification_note: Changes selection unit, not output vocabulary.

claims.claim: SpanBERT samples span lengths from a geometric distribution with p=0.2, maximum length 10 and average span length around 3.8 words.
SpanBERT adds a Span Boundary Objective using span boundary representations and relative position embeddings.
ALBERT SOP uses positive consecutive segments and negative examples formed by reversing their order.
claims.verification_note: SOP construction described in the paper.
